_what: #763 hand-checked section boundaries: the truth the sec_forms cutters (ours-1, ours-2, the pinned edgartools worker) are scored against. Unlike the *_golden.json files this is not a capture of any cutter's output; every boundary was read by hand off the document.
_status: DRAFT 2026-11-17: 20 cases read once by one reader (Claude), not yet second-checked; the agreement block is empty and the scorer is not written. Do not quote scores from it until a second reading confirms the boundaries.
_text: Offsets index rcdata.sec_sections.strip_html(document) of the stored raw document; doc_sha256 is that text's SHA-256, so a changed strip_html or a different download shows up as a mismatch instead of a silent shift. head/tail are the first and last 60 characters of the section with whitespace collapsed, the keys a scorer matches on when offsets do not line up.
_boundary: start = the first character of the line that holds the section's own heading in the body (never the TOC line); end = the first character of the line holding the next heading that is not part of the section (exclusive). item_1 = 10-K Item 1 up to Item 1A; item_4 = 20-F Item 4 up to Item 4A; aif_business = General Development of the Business plus Description of the Business, up to the first of Risk Factors, the reserves statement, Dividends or Capital Structure. expect='crossref' means the document carries no such section, only a Form 20-F/AIF cross-reference table, and the right answer is 'missing'/'crossref', not a slice.
_held_out: A change to a cutter may not edit this file. A boundary found wrong is corrected in its own commit with the reading that justifies it, and the scores before and after are both reported (#763).
